description: Commercial profile of one robot (specs, pricing, viability score), plus whether a per-robot semiconductor bill of materials exists for it. The commercial fields are identical in all three get_robot variants - the layer flag is the only difference. Also returns observed_capabilities: the evidence label per capability, as published on the robot's page; the observations behind the labels need get_robot_capabilities.
name: hardware_get_robot
title: Robot profile (semiconductor coverage)
